rejected_rule.statement: A lessee does not have the right of retention after the expiration of the lease, and such a person's right to compensation is subject to different considerations than those applicable to a possessor with possessio civilis.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "A lessee's right, if any, to compensation for improvements is subject to considerations totally different from those applicable to the rights of a person having the possessio civilis" - Walter Pereira in his Laws of Ceylon (2nd ed., pp. 353, 354).
